name: Eccentric Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Lower yourself as slowly as possible — aim for 3-5 seconds down.
Keep the body rigid and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Once your chest nears the floor, reset to the top. The slow lowering builds full push-up strength.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner bodyweight press-pattern exercise targeting the chest. Eccentric Push-Up builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
